tools.name: compare_prices
tools.description: Compare the latest FIPE price and history of up to 10 vehicles side by side. Each spec is "model-slug,fuel-slug,year"; separate specs with semicolons.

tools.name: get_price
tools.description: Get the latest FIPE price for one vehicle, identified by model_slug + fuel_acronym + year, or by model_id + fuel_id + year. Year is "2022" (a model year) or "zero" (0 km / brand new).

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Get the monthly FIPE price history for one vehicle, identified by model_id + fuel_id + year. Year is "2022" (a model year) or "zero" (0 km / brand new).

tools.name: search_vehicles
tools.description: Search Brazilian FIPE vehicles by free-text query (make, model, year, fuel). Returns matching vehicles with their slugs and IDs — the entry point that resolves names into the identifiers get_price, get_price_history and compare_prices need.
